_purpose: Lane B (R6, class-foundation pass, docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-12-class-foundation.md) hand-off doc: the forward-reference this lane's 6 new trap placements leave for Lane A's R1 Rogue ladder (find_trap L3 / disarm_trap L5) and the controller to reconcile at merge. Mirrors docs/design/pallass-staging/phase-c-forward-references.json's shape (the 8e precedent).
why_parked: R1 pins disarm_trap as the GENERALIZED disarm verb every trap-class prop should re-point to, with the existing requires_skill=observe shape staying live as the no-Rogue fallback. On lane-cfB's own tree, data/skills.json has no disarm_trap entry (Lane A owns skills.json/classes.json, serialized after Lane B in the merge order) -- setting a new prop's requires_skill to "disarm_trap" today would NOT fail tests/test_content.gd (_validate_props does not cross-reference requires_skill against the skill catalog), but it WOULD make the disarm branch structurally unreachable: known_skills().has("disarm_trap") is always false until the skill exists, so every player gets the generic locked fallback forever, trap_disarmed never banks, and the new trap_canonical QA script (qa/scripts/trap_canonical.json) could not prove a live disarm leg. Shipping requires_skill="observe" now keeps the disarm mechanically live and test-provable today, matching the plan's own instruction: "the observe-based fallback stays live either way."
open_question_for_controller: R1's own text says the EXISTING dart_slit_a-style disarm should keep observe as a 'no-Rogue fallback' once disarm_trap ships -- but a single requires_skill field only holds one skill id, so a straight swap (as tabulated above) would REMOVE the observe path entirely for these 6 new props, not fall back to it. Two shapes resolve this, controller's call: (a) generalize requires_skill to accept an array (checked via `known_skills().has(any of req_skill)`, first-known-wins for hint copy) -- one small wi_game.gd/field_skills.gd change, touches every requires_skill site; (b) leave these 6 AS-IS on observe permanently (they were never dart_slit-class dungeon content gated behind a trap_kit item, just world flavor -- observe-only may simply be the right final state for them, and disarm_trap stays reserved for higher-stakes placements like trapped_halls' own dart_slit_a). Recommend (b) unless Lane A's own R1 work already generalizes the field for trapped_halls' dart_slit_a -- if it does, apply the swap_table above in the same pass for consistency.
trap_disarmed_producer_note: trap_disarmed is banked LIVE today by all 6 placements' on_skill_use (via the observe fallback) -- a produced-but-unconsumed accomplishment counter, verified legal (test_content.gd has no producer-needs-a-consumer check; only the reverse, a required accomplishment needs a producer). Whatever Lane A's Rogue ladder gates on this counter (e.g. a gained_by/level threshold) will start reading real data the moment a player disarms any of these 6 -- no re-wiring needed on this side.
